newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on position-squaring.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on position-squaring.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dropped at Tuesday's close amid settlement day position-squaring and dealers said the market was unlikely to firm on Wednesday.
"Absence of local and foreign institutional investors is likely to keep the market mixed to weak in the next few sessions," dealer Ali Hussain Rajabali said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 12.56 points, or 0.80 percent, to end at 1,563.09. Losers led gainers 195 to 49. Turnover fell to 32 million shares from 41 million in the previous session.
Bank of Punjab fell 0.70 rupees to 27.15 rupees. Adamjee Insurance fell 3.0 to 107. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 0.70 to 37.45. Cherat Cement fell 1.0 to 23.
Hub Power Co fell 0.10 to 37.95 but Pakistan State Oil rose 1.0 to 299. PTCL fell 0.40 to 28.65. Fauji Fertilizer fell 2.25 to 77 and ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 21.75.
